_comment: Slakh2100 train split, pre-encoded with the streamgen accompaniment control. Same mechanism as local_babyslakh_streamgen.json, on the full corpus with the official Slakh splits, which is what 1.2 needs to say anything about generalization. Pass --sample_size 16760832 on the CLI (4092 latent frames, 380s, covering the 95th percentile track length): pre_encode_dataset.py's merge_config_into_args treats any argparse default that is not None as CLI-supplied, so a 'sample_size' key here would be silently ignored. Run with --batch_size 1 and no --pad so each track keeps its natural length.
